note: Both sets are nearly identical and largely faithful to the Finish and Millwork schedules, but Set A keeps the wall base material (MDF) as a condition and tags the accent paint claim with P3, while Set B drops MDF from the wall base profile claim and states the accent paint only by description. Both sets add an unsupported 'location: KITCHEN' condition to the quartz claims and render the glass location 'SHOWER SURROUND' as 'BATHROOM SHOWER'. Set B's omission of the MDF material is the only real loss of engineering information, so A is marginally better.
remarks: The page never states a KITCHEN location for the quartz (QZ) entry, which has no LOCATION field at all; both sets invented that condition (2 claims each). The glass (GL) location is printed as 'SHOWER SURROUND', not 'BATHROOM SHOWER' — a mild paraphrase both sets share. Also, the quantity claims quote only the bare numeral '2', which does not by itself support binding to MWB02/MWB03; the text layer is heavily jumbled (tags and values out of row order), so row binding should be checked against the image, which is legible.
